name: Apature 0.1.0 test build 159
body:
Based on [Apature by McCal-Codes](https://github.com/McCal-Codes/apature). Changes in this edition by Andrew Salcedo:

- Photo Mechanic keyboard shortcuts (the default; Apature classic is still in Settings › Shortcuts)
- RAW preview extraction for all major cameras (Fujifilm, Canon CR3/CRW, Panasonic, Olympus, Sony, Sigma, Hasselblad, Phase One and more)
- Select By rating, color class and tag (Edit menu)
- Copy Photos (File › Copy Photos…, ⌘Y)
- Extract JPEG Previews from RAW (Tools menu)
- Sidebar folder tree
- G closes Preview
- Ratings saved to XMP sidecars (originals untouched)
- Rating and preview fixes (rating a photo no longer makes it jump)
- Help › Report a Bug…

This test build works on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs (macOS 12 or later).

## How to install
1. Download `Apature-0.1.0-test-159-universal.dmg` below and open it.
2. Drag Apature into Applications.
3. The first time, right-click Apature and choose **Open**. If macOS still blocks it, go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. This is needed because the test build isn't notarized by Apple.

## Found a bug?
Use **Help › Report a Bug…** in the app, or open an issue on the [Issues tab](https://github.com/Salcedoandrew/salcedos-apature/issues).
